data.body:
[P2] Release invoke holds when their owning context completes

Extend the added `minSuccessful: 1`/`neverReturns` scenario with a one-hour `context.wait` after the parallel completes, inside the same handler. The abandoned non-durable invoke remains tracked until the entire execution unregisters, so this condition prevents the subsequent wait from skipping time. It instead takes an hour of real time and also blocks skipping for unrelated runners sharing the clock. Associate each hold with its invoke operation and ancestor context, and release it when that context completes without the result. Add coverage for continuing the same execution after the race.
